title: Adding Part Sales starts with what new part sales would get
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B, so that Service Labor and Service Parts hold different people.
  • Create a customer for this test with "Sales Representative - Service Labor" set to sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" set to sales rep B, and no Part Sales field, so you can see that Part Sales copies Service Parts, not Service Labor.
  • Open the customer's Edit Customer window in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the +.
  2. Click "Sales Representative - Part Sales".
  3. Hover over the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Part Sales".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • "Sales Representative - Part Sales" shows last, under Service Parts.
  • It reads sales rep B (the person new part sales get today).
  • It has a remove x to its right.
  • The + is no longer shown beside the first field, because both fields have been added.

Step 3:

  • The tooltip reads "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 13 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R6: “Its menu lists, in this order, each field not yet added: "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales". When both are added the + is not shown.”
  • S4-R8: “Adding Part Sales shows "Sales Representative - Part Sales" last. It starts with the person new part sales get at that moment (S4-R26), or "Unassigned". Under S4-R27 a person whose Sales Representative switch is off or whose account is deactivated is never copied: the added field then starts "Unassigned", and the field they hold keeps them (S4-N2).”
  • S4-R9: “The fields always show in this order: the first field ("Sales Representative", or "Sales Representative - Service Labor" once Service Parts is added), then Service Parts, then Part Sales.”
  • S4-R10: “Service Parts and Part Sales each have the remove x of S2-R8 to their right, with the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" or "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales". The first field has the + instead, while there is something left to add, and otherwise no button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
